name: framepilot
description: FramePilot — Cursor for video editing. AI edits the timeline via typed, validated, reversible patches executed by a deterministic Python render engine.
invariants: Non-destructive: never modify or delete original media.
Every AI edit is a typed timeline operation.
Check every render automatically after it runs.
AI edits only via registered schema-validated tools and returns reversible patches; never raw project.fp.json mutation.

timeline-engineer.description: Builds and maintains typed timeline operations and the patch engine (apply/invert/validate/diff/undo). Build the engine before the AI layer.

render-debugger.description: Debugs failed MoviePy/FFmpeg renders and render-validation failures; adds regression and golden-media tests.

ai-tooling.description: Adds AI tools and orchestrator modes safely. Every tool needs schema + validation + reversibility + tests, and returns a patch.

security-reviewer.description: Reviews path sandboxing, agent sandbox, Electron hardening, render timeout/cancellation, secrets, and dependency/license risk.

qa-e2e.description: Writes and maintains Playwright e2e and golden-media tests for critical flows; enforces coverage gates.

mcp-engineer.description: Builds and maintains the MCP server (packages/mcp-server) that exposes FramePilot's registered editing tools to external AI agents. Keeps the MCP tool surface auto-synced with the canonical tool registry; edits go through validate→apply→save; paths are sandboxed; rendering delegates to the Python sidecar.

changelog-maintainer.description: Maintains the public, customer-facing changelog on the marketing website (apps/website/content/changelog → /changelog). Translates shipped user-visible changes into plain-language, benefit-first entries; never leaks engineering detail or repo links.

lead-prompt-engineer.description: Crafts every string the model reads and every model-authored string the user sees: the system contract and context-builder prompt blocks, tool names/descriptions (TS + Python mirror), orchestrator mode instructions, and model-layer UI copy. Applies agent-harness prompt patterns (Claude Code, Codex) for an audience of video editors, not programmers; enforces model/UI/customer audience separation, determinism, and token/cache discipline.

plan-keeper.description: Reads, updates, and reconciles plan/PLAN.md (and sub-plans) — marks task status, adds discovered tasks, keeps the snapshot/date current. Invoke at the start and end of units of work.

docs-maintainer.description: Keeps docs/ and CHANGELOG.md current — writes guides/API docs, authors ADRs for decisions, and records user-facing changes. Invoke whenever code changes behavior, APIs, or architecture.

performance-monitor.description: Measures, budgets, and guards FramePilot's performance — profiles the editor, defines and enforces interaction/render/decode budgets, adds non-flaky perf-regression tests, and produces before/after evidence for optimization work. Measures and gates; does not do broad feature rewrites.

performance-optimizer.description: Makes FramePilot fast — diagnoses and fixes runtime performance problems (React re-render storms, timeline drag/zoom/scrub lag, thumbnail/waveform decode cost, media-bin/asset lag, AI-sidebar event churn) without changing behavior, schema, or the five invariants. Optimizes features; never removes them.

editing-skills-expert.description: Writes and maintains the bundled agent skills in packages/ai-sdk/skills/*.md — the expert editing playbooks the AI loads on demand via load_skill. Grounds every recipe in the real tool registry, schema, and render engine; never assumes a capability exists. Invoke when adding a skill, improving editing craft guidance, or when a skill drifts from what the tools/engine actually do.
